review_description: Excellent and punctual and great training provided on the day. No questions were stupid ( that we asked!)

We spent several weeks back and forth with recommended suppliers. It came down to a choice between two. Shane form Amplify electrical won the job from us because of his willingness to go over and over the quote, explain what we needed to understand about the system, and his frank and honest advice. The deciding factor for us was the fact that Amplify Electrical is his own business and has his own crew with no subcontractors involved. Who you buy it off is who installs it and who will be around to service it in the future. The team turned up on time as arranged, cleaned up after themselves, and did a cracking job of the install, nothing was too much trouble. Even moved the TV ariel and sorted out a few power points as part of the job so everything that we asked for was attended to in the one quote with a fixed price. Highly recommend Shane and Amplify electrical for Solar sales and installation.
Best customer service experience I have received in many years. Reasonably priced, great workmanship. Trades efficient, on time, helpful, so on and so on. 110% recommend.

Amplify Electrical came out to site to inspect the roof, location, neighbouring tress, and sent back a quote within 24 hours. They gave us 6 options to choose from including different inverter types and different solar panel types to suit budget level, mid-range level, and highest quality level and pricing. Once we selected the system we wanted, they worked with us regarding the installation timing as we were also restoring our roof at the time. The installation went smoothly. All the tradesmen acted very professionally, were friendly and informative, and were tidy. Customer service was exceptional with text messages, emails and prompt replies to any of our queries.

Incredible knowledge of systems and even gave me pros and cons of what is available from competitors quotes. Was able to supply and adapt quote to exactly what I needed and wanted. Nothing was too hard. I got a massive system and its output is well over what I expected. Has set me up for battery installation once upcoming rebates are announced with an extra channel for more panels to get the absolute maximum number of panels possible. You can’t go past this installer. Once you’ve got all your other quotes contact amplify and you will be looked after. Definitely not a dodgy installer. And I found by all means will give you really good value for money. Has organised everything and  as a customer. I feel very satisfied and confident in my choice of installer and has left. No question unanswered or problem unsolved.

The installation process was very easy and informative. Amplify electrical not only delivered the cheapest quote for a like for like system but also offered tigo optimisers as a solution for some of my panels being shaded during the day.Another thing of note is what solar quotes mentions on how to identify good installers, and that is how they deal with a problem client/install or a bad review etc. In our case everything was going really well until we got home after the install and an outdoor garden pipe connection had blown apart due to the heat of the day. It was unclear whether the guys onsite even used the hose but either way, the guys at amplify immediately offered a discount at twice the amount of the maximum amount of water I calculated that may have been lost. My partner and I were really happy with this solution.A great group of people, I’ve been recommending this group to all my friends and family.

Amplify were great because:* They visited the site prior to quotation to ensure quotation didn’t include rubbery allowances.* Generously answered 2 hours worth of questions to help me decide on system design.* Gave detailed itemisation in quotation so that I could confidence in what i was agreeing to.

I highly recommend Shane and his team at Amplify Electrical.The sales and quoting process was really good. Shane brought many different ideas to the table, options that I hadn't considered. I also liked how he knew that keeping the wife happy in how the system looked was a priority! Shane had great comms and was very flexible in the quoting process.The installation went really well. The team came in and got the install done promptly and professionally. They also did a decent job at handover stage.We had a minor issue where the battery wasn't set up on the correct circuits in event of a black out, however the team came back and fixed everything without any extra charge.Overall, I'm super what Amplify quoted me on and delivered. It's working really well and already saving us money.

We needed installation of a large solar system. The background information from Solar Quotes was immensely useful.   We sought 4 quotes in total.  Three were from the Solar Quotes site, each had a 5 star rating and were located in Brisbane (where we live).  We also asked for a quote from our Electricity supplier. We chose Amplify Electrical because it was competitive and thorough.  All 3 companies from the Solar Quotes site were very good and all gave on site quotes. Shane, who owns Amplify Electrical gave an on-site quote having spent a lot of time explaining the process and making useful suggestions.The installation took an entire day and required 8 people, including Shane. All the staff were punctual, professional and respectful.  Their work was meticulous. We were very happy with the work and would highly recommend Amplify Electrical for solar systems. The after sale service has also been excellent.  We were contacted because Shane found that our system was producing less power than expected and a technician came and rectified the problem (some of the solar panels were not properly connected).
Came out to site to quote. Installation was smooth and well done. After sales great. Would recommend them.
Performance and professional practices all well done, and with plenty of communication.Very reliable.

I would highly recommend Amplify for solar install. We had several quotes. Amplify weren't the cheapest or dearest but the only company where the owner/electrician visited personally to measure the roof and accurately advice on the size system we needed. Other companies either advised over the phone or by salesmen and advised on large solar systems which were unrealistic.  The install team were very professional and organized and did a great job.  Thank you Shane and team.

As a senior female, I am totally lost in this wonderful world of solar energy. I sought guidance and assurances from Amplify and had all my anxiety removed by the helpful, informative people at Amplify. They arrived and completed the installation when stated.  Did all the necessary paperwork, and took all the stress from my shoulders.  I am happy.

Solar Quotes made it very easy to select our installer for our solar.  Amplify were knowledgeable, professional and easy to work with.  No question too stupid!  Felt we were dealing with qualified, professional company.  Happy to recommend Amplify.  Job well done.
All went smoothly and delivered as promised - good job

I recently had the pleasure of working with Amplify Electrical for a solar system installation, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team, including Shane, Harri, and Brighid, provided exceptional customer service that truly set them apart.The installation itself was top-notch, showcasing their commitment to high-quality work. The attention to detail and expertise demonstrated during the process gave me confidence that I made the right choice with Amplify Electrical.What truly sets them apart, though, is the impeccable after-support. Any questions or concerns I had were addressed promptly and effectively, leaving me with peace of mind knowing that they stand behind their work.If you're in need of a solar system installation and value not only the quality of work but also outstanding customer service, look no further than Amplify Electrical. They've earned my trust and appreciation, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone considering a solar project.

Amplify Electrical were recommended to me by SolarQuotes and were the first company to reply to my request for a quote. Shane was willing to come on site and talk me through the proposed installation and took the time to inspect my existing meter board and wiring and offered to make some minor upgrades as part of the install.None of the other 3 companies that I contacted offered the level of communication and thoroughness that was displayed by Amplify Electrical.The office staff were very pleasant to deal with and the installation team had been out and installed the system within a week of my accepting the quote. The installation itself was very quick and efficient and I was impressed with how quickly I was able to start seeing the benefits of solar power. Harry was very helpful and kept me informed as the installation progressed and was prepared to show me how to set up and interpret  the monitoring apps once the system was up and going.The company dealt with all the paper work associated with upgrading the meter and contacted my retailer and electricity provider on my behalf. They were prepared to organise an installer to provide a cover for the inverter and even shared the cost. Given that this work was not in the original quote I was very happy that they were prepared to go that extra mile.They also took the time to email a manual for my system so that I could discover the ins and outs of operating the inverter etc. I would definitely recommend Amplify Electrical to anyone who is considering installing solar.

All companies (5 in all ) provided quotes  only two actually did a site visit and only one followed up and provided additional information to help us decide on the system we needed. Only one provided information about the installation, location of Inverter and ways to make the system not detract from the look of the house.  Much of the information was generic and not specific to our property which would have caused some issues on the install day.  Particularly in relation to the location of the panels , cables and inverter.Amplify was the only company who provided the information,  alternative options  and specific details about the full project. Nothing was left to chance and we were aware of every detail prior to signing the contract. The install was exactly as expected with no surprises. Shane the sales man was informative , patient and actually got on to the roof and measured the screw lines which made a significant difference to the location of panels. all other quotes failed to find this problem. The install team did exactly what they planned in timing etc . They were courteous and efficient not radio noise or audible swearing and cleaned up after themselves. The quoted price was very competitive and Shane provided alternative options for us to consider . They took care of all the paperwork to connect to the grid , meter upgrade and app download etcOverall this has been positive experience and we have recommended Amplify to three friends who are installing solar systems .
The installer was very knowledgeable, patient, courteous and professional. Made sure to answer all my questions. On time service with great follow up. Connection to the grid was faultless.
Clear information around the options available. Prompt and straightforward service, from questing to installation. Whole process was very quick. Thanks Shane, Harry and team.

Shane visited my residence and explained the process (same as all the other installers) within a reasonable time from when the quotes were requested. The proposed system (Jinko N-type 6.64kw plus Sungrow 5kw) and the price was the best I got from the 3 companies.Amplify processed my paperwork and requests in a timely manner. Signed the quote on 30 Aug and installation scheduled 19 Sep. Installation proceeded without a hitch and the system was running without any issues since.Shane has been helpful with questions I had even after the installation and this is highly appreciated as well.

I had a fantastic experience with Amplify for the installation of my new solar panel system. From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to work with.The quoting process was informative and hassle-free. They took the time to understand my goals for going solar and recommended the ideal system and components for my home and energy needs. I never felt pressured or pushed into any decisions.The owner came out promptly to assess my house and provide an accurate quote. He was patient in answering all of my questions and outlining the costs and expected energy production.The installation team arrived on schedule and completed the job efficiently in just one day. They took great care working on my roof and cleaning up afterwards. The project manager stayed in close communication with me throughout the process.I'm very happy with my new solar system. It was thoughtfully designed for my specific home. The entire staff was friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend Amplify to anyone considering going solar. Their expertise and customer service are outstanding.

Shane and his crew at Amplify Electrical did a great job with my solar installation.  The customer service was great and he really went the extra mile to fit me in despite my rough schedule.  Would highly recommend them.
Shane and Amplify Electrical were absolutely wonderful to work with. His electricians and installers were knowledgeable and courteous and happy to answer all my questions.

Shane was great to deal with at evey touchpoint - he was able to explain the different options in simple terms and was never once pushy. Installation was scheduled quickly and the team arrived on time. They were friendly and professional and did a great job on the roof including trimming the vent pipes and only needing one replacement tile, and with the full switchboard upgrade. Pre and post-installation service from the Amplify admin team was friendly, clear and helpful. All in all a great experience!

One of the few installers that didn’t put any pressure on me to buy from them. Shane was friendly, knew his stuff and didn’t make me feel stupid. Installation went smoothly and all went well. Can’t fault them!

Initial quoting process through Amplify Electrical was fuss free and quite quick. The representative listened to customer input and provided their input also.Installation day was seamless, Amplify Electrical notified me within the hour of the technician turning up, and Installation was efficient and technicians cleaned and tidied up their mess upon exiting.All grid connections were organised through the company leaving the customer to complete nothing but the initial quotation paperwork.Very happy with their service and would definitely recommend to others.

The on site visit and quoting was a pleasure, with the representative not only discussing the different systems, but they  measured the roof to check that they could fit the required number of panels and the placement of the inverter.The installation team was on time, polite and tidy, the customer service was awesome and the grid connection after the install. I highly recommend them.

Shane from Amplify electrical was extremely patient with my many questions and provided multiple quotes so I could appropriately assess all options and pick the most suitable option for me.Very happy with the installation, it was quick and tidy. The admin was always super quick regarding booking me in, notifying of payment received, and they organised everything with Energex.
